A commonly used romanization based on etymology is ''Zir''. |text=fff |image=Zirc anime.png |size=200px |caption=Zirc |age=UnconfirmedAs of ''[[HZ092|Following Traces of Laquium]]'', Zirc is a year older than at the start of {{aniseries|HZ}} |gender=Male |hair=Black with an olive mohawk |eyes=Orange |hometown=Unknown |region=Unknown }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{ghost color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' |debut=''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'' |enva=[[Michael Schneider]] |jpva=[[Kohsuke Tanabe]] }} {{Character Infobox/Team |color={{ghost color light}} |member=[[Explorers]] |rank=Agent }} |} '''Zirc''' (Japanese: '''ジル''' ''Gilles'') is a member of the [[Explorers]] and a former supporting antagonist in {{aniseries|HZ}}. He is also [[Amethio]]'s subordinate alongside [[Onia]]. After Amethio's disappearance, he and Onia started acting as double agents against [[Spinel]]. ==In animation== ===History=== ====Pre-series==== As revealed in ''[[HZ104|Charcadet's Wish]]'', at some point prior to ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'', Zirc alongside [[Onia]] joined the Explorers after being recruited by [[Hamber]], who assigned him to serve as [[Amethio]]'s direct subordinate. At first, Zirc was less than pleased about having to serve a child, but as he and Amethio continued working together, Zirc came to genuinely respect him and pledged loyalty to him. ===={{aniseries|HZ}}==== Zirc debuted in ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'' alongside the other members of the [[Explorers]]. Zirc was the first one to find [[Liko]] and her {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}} after they tried to escape and confronted them with his {{p|Rhydon}}, only for it to be subdued by Sprigatito's aroma. When [[Friede]] from the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] swoop in to defend Liko, [[Amethio]] stopped him and [[Onia]] from assisting. After Friede escaped with Liko in the [[HZ002|next episode]], him and the rest of the Explorers gave chase, broke through the [[Brave Olivine|airship]]'s defenses, and threatened Liko to give herself up. Friede stopped them from leaving and battled Amethio once more, but they managed to escape after Liko's Sprigatito unleashed a {{m|Leafage}} strong enough to break the forcefield around the battlefield, taking it as a hostage in the process. In ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]'', Zirc kept an eye on the Brave Olivine whilst most of the members of the Rising Volt Tacklers were searching for Sprigatito. Unseen by [[Ludlow]] who remained onboard the Brave Olivine [[fishing]], Zirc was able to place an unknown device on the ship. As of ''[[HZ006|The Ancient Poké Ball]]'', after leaving without a mission to complete, that was now given by [[Spinel]], Zirc decided to follow Amethio in order to discover more about the {{Shiny|Black}} [[Black Rayquaza|Rayquaza]] that was summoned from [[Roy]]'s ancient [[Poké Ball]]. In ''[[HZ021|The Lonely Hatenna]]'', Zirc with Amethio and Onia arrived in the [[Galar]] [[region]] in order to investigate the [[Galar Mine]]. In the [[HZ022|next episode]], Zirc and his team arrived at the Galar Mine where they came across Roy, Liko, and Friede and they battled them. However, the two groups witnessed a {{rf|Galarian}} {{TP|Lucius|Moltres}} that had an Ancient Poké Ball arrive and attack them. Seeing how powerful Moltres was, Zirc and Onia retreated from their battle against Roy and Liko. In the [[HZ023|following episode]], the two reunited with Amethio and agreed to help him get the {{an|Terapagos|Pokémon}} that was in Liko's pendant. [[File:Onia Zirc disguise HZ083.png|250px|left|thumb|Zirc and [[Onia]] disguised as [[Exceed]] employees]] In ''[[HZ024|Reunion at the Ancient Castle!]]'', Zirc, Amethio, and Onia reported their findings to [[Hamber]]. Later, they followed Liko, Roy, and Friede to the [[old castle]] in [[Hammerlocke]] and surrounded them in order to take the Pokémon away. In the [[HZ025|next episode]], Zirc tried to prevent Roy and Liko's escape, but failed. However, he was able to find Roy and Liko again, so he and Onia forced them to battle. During the battle, Zirc and Onia retreated once he noticed the {{m|Salt Cure}} [[move]] from [[Sidian]]'s {{p|Garganacl}} on the castle's [[wild Pokémon]]. In ''[[HZ033|Roar of the Black Rayquaza]]'', Zirc, Amethio, and Onia were able to locate Rayquaza. Amethio told his subordinates to remain on standby whilst he went to confront it. After Amethio's battle against Black Rayquaza in ''[[HZ045|From So Far Away]]'', Zirc appeared with Onia to check if Amethio was okay, then the group returned to the Explorers' base. In ''[[HZ054|The Treasure of Eternity]]'', it was revealed that Zirc and Onia were spying on Spinel under Amethio's orders. [[File:Onia and Zirc HZ087.png|250px|thumb|Zirc and Onia helping [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]] against their fellow [[Explorers]]]] In ''[[HZ068|Into a New Sky! The Brave Olivine!]]'', following Amethio's temporary ban from the Explorers, Amethio informed Zirc and Onia that he was planning on going on a mission on his own. Showing loyalty to Amethio, Zirc and Onia insisted on accompanying him. In ''[[HZ083|The Truth Revealed!]]'', Zirc, Amethio, and Onia infiltrated the Exceed building to uncover what Spinel was scheming, only to end up captured by security. They were freed by Hamber, who took them to [[Amethio's mansion]] and told them about Gibeon's past and his association with [[Laqua]]. Believing Spinel was manipulating Gibeon in order to obtain the [[Laquium]] himself, Amethio set for Laqua with Zirc and Onia by his side. In ''[[HZ087|Guided by the Black Rayquaza!]]'', after arriving in Laqua, Zirc and Onia helped Liko, Roy, and [[Dot]] get past [[Coral]], [[Sidian]], and [[Chalce]], who were guarding where the Laquium was hidden. Though fearful of their superiors' wrath, Zirc and Onia stood by their decision and were prepared to face whatever punishment they received. In ''[[HZ089|Where the Adventure Leads]]'', when Laqua began collapsing due to Spinel's actions, Zirc and Onia returned to Amethio and convinced him to flee the area with them. In ''[[HZ092|Following Traces of Laquium]]'', a year after the events at Laqua, Zirc and Onia had become separated from their boss Amethio, whose whereabouts were unknown. Hamber, not believing Spinel's report that Amethio had betrayed Gibeon and that both had died in Laqua, secretly entrusted Zirc and Onia with a mission to find him as well as the White Zygarde, being given a [[Zygarde Cube]] in doing so. [[File:Zirc Ticket.png|250px|left|thumb|Zirc and his ticket for the Nidothing and Iono event]] In ''[[HZ101|Terastallization vs. Mega Evolution!]]'', Zirc appeared with Onia somewhere at sea trying to find Amethio's whereabouts. Like Onia, he was upset about not being able to find their boss, but stated that all they could do was continue searching for him. In ''[[HZ103|Nidothing Love!]]'', while taking a break from searching for Amethio in [[Levincia]], Onia discovered that Zirc was planning to join a handshake event hosted by Nidothing and {{an|Iono}}. The next day, as he approached the event venue, a gust of wind blew Zirc's ticket into a nearby storm drain. When Liko and her friends happened upon the depressed Zirc, they agreed to help find the ticket. They tracked the ticket to a nearby beach, where it ended up stuck on top of a wild {{p|Wugtrio}}'s head. Everyone battled Wugtrio together, giving Zirc's Rhydon the opportunity to retrieve the ticket. Later, once the event had ended, Zirc came across Nidothing without her suit, accidentally discovering her true identity was Dot. Afterward, Zirc and Onia approached Liko, where they revealed that Amethio was missing and personally asked her to assist them in finding him. In ''[[HZ104|Charcadet's Wish]]'', after paying a visit to Amethio's mansion, Zirc, Onia, and Liko began looking for clues that would help them determine where Amethio was located. When Liko's {{TP|Liko|Charcadet}} came across one of Amethio's childhood photos, Zirc and Onia called [[Cervantis]], who explained he took the photo while on a family vacation years ago. Off the coast of Levincia, everyone found Amethio alive, but in hiding on an island to avoid being captured by Spinel's agents. Zirc and Onia begged Amethio to take Exceed and the Explorers from Spinel's grasp, but he refused, stating that with Gibeon's passing, he was powerless to do anything. With words of encouragement from Liko and a battle with her Charcadet, Amethio managed to regain the resolve to fight against Spinel's machinations. Despite this, Amethio refused to go with Zirc and Onia, stating that as members of the Explorers, there were things they could accomplish on the inside that he couldn't. Accepting this, Zirc passed on the Zygarde Cube to Amethio before leaving the island with Onia. Afterward, Zirc and Onia reported to Hamber that Amethio was safe and sound. In [[HZ124]], Zirc joined forces with Onia and Amethio's to battle three [[Explorers]]'s {{p|Golbat}}, {{p|Marowak}}, and {{p|Shelgon}} to cause a distraction, allowing the Rising Volt Tacklers to infiltrate the Explorers HQ. Later, Amethio contacted him and Onia to watch the back of the building in case something goes wrong before Dot thanks the pair for their help causing Zirc to become slightly flustered at Dot's words and Amethio, Liko, Roy, Dot and Ult entered the HQ. In [[HZ134]], Zirc, Onia, and Amethio reunited with Liko as she was with [[Diana]], [[Captain Pikachu]], and [[Ann]] on Laqua's summit. When Spinel utilized his Laquium-activating machines to drive the resident wild Pokémon berserk, Zirc lent his aid to help pacify them. After Captain Pikachu and Pagogo destroyed the machines and purified the afflicted Pokémon, Zirc and Onia left with Zygarde to move the Pokémon to safety. ===Character=== Zirc has a cocky personality and is also shown to be ruthless and violent like a brute, Zirc obeying the orders of his superiors such as [[Amethio]] without questioning. He is also secretly a fan of [[Dot|Nidothing]] and watches her videos, where he submits questions under the username "''Rhydon's Muscles''" (Japanese: '''サイドンの筋肉''' ''{{p|Rhydon|Sidon}}'s Muscles''). He's a fan like [[Liko]] and really loves Nidothing's events, which is something he shares with his {{p|Rhydon}}. Zirc is also humble as he knows when to ask for help, as shown in ''[[HZ103|Nidothing Love!]]'', where he and [[Onia]] personally asked Liko to join them in their search to find Amethio. Zirc is shown to be loyal to his boss, as seen in ''[[HZ068|Into a New Sky! The Brave Olivine!]]'', when he insisted on accompanying Amethio on his mission after being dismissed from the Explorers. In ''[[HZ104|Charcadet's Wish]]'', it's revealed that he and Onia were a little judgmental of Amethio when they first met him but his perspective of Amethio changed overtime and he became completely loyal to him and wants to help him showing he cares for Amethio as a friend and superior. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Zirc's only known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|HZ}}: ====On hand==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Zirc |pkmn=Rhydon |type1=Ground |type2=Rock |img=Zirc Rhydon.png |epnum=HZ001 |epname=The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One) |vajp=Kenta Miyake |vaen=Marc Thompson |desc={{p|Rhydon}} is Zirc's first known Pokémon and his main battler. He first used it to battle [[Liko]] and her {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}, but it was quickly subdued due to Sprigatito's aroma. In ''[[HZ005|Found You, Fuecoco!]]'', Rhydon was used to battle members of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]], battling against {{TP|Murdock|Rockruff}} and {{p|Chansey}} before battling {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}}, which managed to learn Ember to take Rhydon out of the fight. In ''[[HZ022|Charge! Galar Mine!]]'', Rhydon was sent out to battle against Liko and [[Roy]] again at the [[Galar Mine]]. When [[Lucius's Moltres]] appeared, it attacked everyone in sight and Rhydon ended up getting knocked out by its {{m|Air Slash}} attack, prompting Zirc to [[recall]] his Pokémon and flee. In ''[[HZ024|Reunion at the Ancient Castle!]]'', Rhydon joined [[Onia]]'s {{p|Golduck}} and [[Amethio's Ceruledge]] in ambushing the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] and [[Diana]] at the [[old castle]] in [[Hammerlocke]]. In the [[HZ025|next episode]], Rhydon faced Fuecoco in a rematch and, despite getting hit with a super-effective {{m|Stomping Tantrum}}, it managed to remain standing and was about to retaliate when the battle was called off upon [[Coral]] and [[Sidian]]'s arrival, and Rhydon was promptly recalled as Zirc retreated. In ''[[HZ083|The Truth Revealed!]]'', Rhydon, along with Zirc's {{p|Skarmory}}, as well as Onia and Amethio's Pokémon, were all confiscated by [[Spinel]]'s personal security when they infiltrated [[Exceed]], but were later retrieved by [[Hamber]], and Rhydon happily reunited with its {{pkmn|Trainer}}. It later enjoyed a meal at [[Amethio's mansion]] and confidently agreed with Zirc in regards to assisting Amethio with his decision to reach [[Laqua]]. In ''[[HZ087|Guided by the Black Rayquaza!]]'', Rhydon and Golduck attacked Coral's {{p|Glalie}}, Sidian's {{p|Garganacl}}, and [[Chalce]]'s {{p|Medicham}} with {{m|Rock Slide}} and {{m|Muddy Water}}, respectively, allowing Liko, Roy, and [[Dot]] to pass and reach [[Gibeon]]. In ''[[HZ103|Nidothing Love!]]'', Rhydon and Zirc became excited at the prospect of meeting [[Nidothing]] in [[Levincia]], but ended up losing their ticket. Thankfully, they ultimately managed to find it at the hands of a {{p|Wugtrio}}. With the help of {{p|Meowscarada}}, {{p|Crocalor}}, and Onia's Golduck, Rhydon was able to retrieve the ticket safely. Later during the Nidothing and {{an|Iono}} event, Rhydon was picked to be part of a dancing session with {{TP|Dot|Quaxwell}} that ended with Rhydon chasing Nidothing affectionately, mistaking her for an actual {{p|Nidorina}}. After the event, both Rhydon and Zirc discovered Nidothing's true identity as Dot. In [[HZ124]], Rhydon joined forces with Onia's Golduck and Amethio's Ceruledge to battle three [[Explorers]]'s {{p|Golbat}}, {{p|Marowak}}, and {{p|Shelgon}} to cause a distraction, allowing the Rising Volt Tacklers to infiltrate the Explorers HQ.
